row: This is a source of exercise instruction, provided by Chiropractic & Sports Health in Portland, ME.  These exercises are, in part, designed to rehab specific injuries.  Always consult with a health care professional before performing these exercises to ensure you are doing them correctly and not put yourself at risk on injury.  For a consultation with Dr. Rob Liguori, Dr Sean Murphy, or Dr Lindsay Webber please find us at www.chirosportshealth.com.
